                                ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICA GO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,

is hereby amended by changing all the RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse,

and Multi-Uiiit District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 4-K in the

area bounded by


       a line 100 feet south of and parallel to West 15"' Street; the
       alley next east of and parallel to South Keller Avenue; a line
       125 feet south of and parallel to West 15"' Street; and
       South Keeler Avenue,


to those of an RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District and a corresponding uses district.



SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.
